Contributing is welcome, especially correcting inaccuracies in translations.

On usage of AI tools:
- You can use whatever you want and however much you want of it as long as you accept 100% resposibility for anything that you commit.  
- Keep the contributors list clean and only containing humans; don't delegate commit nor PR actions to your AI agent for this project. Non-humans cannot be assigned responsibility for work.  
- If you wish to give AI further credit, you can add mention of whatever model you used in Acknowledgements chapter of README.md.

Checklist before submitting PR:
- All tests pass.
- Your change works (test manually by verifying it in a local live server).
- If you delegated any work to an AI agent, read and review it yourself and make sure you approve.
